title: Present Perfect: Just, Already, Yet
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora dominas el uso de Just, Already y Yet para hablar del progreso de las tareas en el trabajo.

stages.title: Concepto Teórico: Just, Already y Yet

parts.visual: Usamos JUST para decir que algo pasó hace muy poco tiempo ('acabo de'). Va antes del participio. I have JUST sent the email (Acabo de enviar el correo).
parts.audio: We use JUST to say something happened a very short time ago. It goes before the past participle. Example: I have JUST sent the email.

parts.visual: ALREADY (ya) significa que algo pasó antes de lo esperado. Va antes del participio. I have ALREADY finished (Ya terminé). YET (todavía/ya) se usa en preguntas y negativas, y va al FINAL de la frase. Have you finished YET? (¿Ya terminaste?). I haven't finished YET (No he terminado todavía).
parts.audio: ALREADY means something happened sooner than expected. It goes before the past participle. I have ALREADY finished. YET is used in questions and negative sentences, and it goes at the END of the sentence. Have you finished YET? I haven't finished YET.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige just, already o yet según el contexto.

questions.question: I have ____ spoken to him. (Hace 2 minutos / Acabo de).
Have you sent the report ____? (¿Ya?).
questions.explanation: Pregunta al final de la oración = yet.

questions.question: I haven't read the document ____. (Todavía).
questions.explanation: Negación al final de la oración = yet.

questions.question: Don't worry, I have ____ booked the flight. (Ya lo hice / Antes de lo esperado).
The meeting has ____ started. Come in quickly! (Acaba de).
We have ____ solved the problem. You don't need to help. (Ya).
I have ____ printed the agenda. It's hot! (Acabo de).
She has ____ left the office. You can catch her in the elevator. (Acaba de).
They have ____ paid the invoice. We received the money. (Ya).
We have ____ signed the contract. (Acabamos de).
I have ____ finished the project. It was fast. (Ya).
I have ____ spoken to him, literally 5 seconds ago. (Acabo de).
She has ____ checked the documents. No need to do it again. (Ya).
Have you reviewed the new policy ____? (¿Ya?).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe 'just' (acabo de), 'already' (ya) o 'yet' (todavía / ya al final).

questions.question: I have ____ sent the email. (Acabo de)
I have ____ booked the flight. (Ya lo hice)
I have ____ printed the agenda. (Acabo de)
I have ____ finished the project. (Ya lo terminé)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I have just sent the email.
options: I have just sent the email.
I have already sent the email.
I haven't sent the email yet.
questions.correct_answer: I have just sent the email.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Have you sent the report yet?
options: Have you sent the report yet?
Have you already sent the report?
Did you send the report yet?
Have you sent the email yet?
questions.correct_answer: Have you sent the report yet?

questions.question: Listen carefully.

I haven't read the email yet.
I have already read the document.
